name: DICICLOVERINE 10 MG 30 TABLETS SEDICLON
description: Dicycloverine 10 mg 30 tablets (Sediclon) is an antispasmodic medication prescribed to relieve the symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other functional gastrointestinal disorders. It works by relaxing the muscles of the stomach and intestines, reducing cramps, pain, bloating, and discomfort. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
